title: Activate Python environments in Agent Host shell commands with shell init scripts
body:
Resolves: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/332046
Part of: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/323164

- Generate one init script per Agent Host Copilot session and register it through the SDK's `shell.initScripts`, so it runs before every built-in shell command.
- Source `~/.bashrc` on macOS and Linux, or the current-user PowerShell profiles on Windows, then run the activation command the Python Environments extension published for the session's folder, reading only that extension's value for the tool shell.
- Gate on the default-off, application-scoped `chat.agentHost.shellTool.initScript.enabled` setting and forward it to the host as the `enableShellInitScript` root flag; the host applies a script only while the flag is true and the SDK shell is in use, and unregisters when either changes.
- Publish only from the Editor Window that owns the session folder; any local window may clear. Keep the value transient and session-only, accept at most one entry of 64 KiB, and reconcile synchronously before each turn.
- Materialize one file per session instance, grant its directory to the SDK sandbox before registration, rewrite in place on change, and delete on dispose once the SDK disconnect settles. Failures are logged and retried on the next turn.
- Encode PowerShell activation as base64 and load each profile under `Continue` in its own try/catch.

Notes:

- The forwarded flag is client-writable root config like every forwarded key. Connected Agent Host clients are trusted and can already run commands, so the setting is the user's opt-in mirrored to the host, not authorization.
- With the SDK sandbox enabled, profile files and activation scripts outside the working directory need `allowRead` entries; profile setup repeats before every shell command; direct script commands may need approval while a script is registered (github/copilot-sdk#2466); the Windows E2E variant is skipped by the Copilot output oracle.

### Validation

- `scripts/test.sh --grep "shell init|shellInitScript|AgentHostShellInitSynchronizer|AgentHostCopilotCliSettingsContribution|copilotCliConfig|buildSandboxConfigForSdk|agentHostSchema|configValues"` — 134 passing
- `./scripts/test-integration.sh --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/e2e/providers/copilotAgentHostE2E.integrationTest.ts --grep "stale model selection|shell init script runs before the shell command"` — 2 passing
- `npx eslint` on the changed files — clean

-----------------------------------------
Inspirations from:

- Profile sourcing before activation, and the `builtin eval` activation with a failure notice, follow [`shellIntegration-bash.sh`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/293593cce438781a8093ad49dd221cf50dcd0d7a/src/vs/workbench/contrib/terminal/common/scripts/shellIntegration-bash.sh#L30-L59) and its [Python activation block](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/293593cce438781a8093ad49dd221cf50dcd0d7a/src/vs/workbench/contrib/terminal/common/scripts/shellIntegration-bash.sh#L100-L119); the PowerShell counterpart follows [`shellIntegration.ps1`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/293593cce438781a8093ad49dd221cf50dcd0d7a/src/vs/workbench/contrib/terminal/common/scripts/shellIntegration.ps1#L77-L92).
- Accepting activation only from the Python Environments extension, scoped to the folder, follows [`blockPythonActivationVar`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/293593cce438781a8093ad49dd221cf50dcd0d7a/src/vs/platform/terminal/common/environmentVariableCollection.ts#L113-L118) and [`filterScope`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/293593cce438781a8093ad49dd221cf50dcd0d7a/src/vs/platform/terminal/common/environmentVariableCollection.ts#L215-L237).
- Forwarding the setting to the host and the `default: false` root key follow the [Agent Host settings forwarder](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/b176e3d456cb38e7e35baa7e8bd72c8f647aa307/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostCopilotCliSettingsContribution.ts#L35-L84) and [`EnableCustomTerminalTool`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/b176e3d456cb38e7e35baa7e8bd72c8f647aa307/src/vs/platform/agentHost/common/copilotCliConfig.ts#L144-L149); schema gating and no-redispatch come from [`AgentHostRootConfigForwarder._push`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/293593cce438781a8093ad49dd221cf50dcd0d7a/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostRootConfigForwarder.ts#L144-L182).
- Per-session registration and pre-turn `reconcile` follow [`AgentHostSessionWorkingDirectorySynchronizer.register`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/b176e3d456cb38e7e35baa7e8bd72c8f647aa307/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionWorkingDirectorySynchronizer.ts#L175-L221) and its handler call sites at [turn preparation](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/b176e3d456cb38e7e35baa7e8bd72c8f647aa307/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionHandler.ts#L2974) and [subscription registration](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/b176e3d456cb38e7e35baa7e8bd72c8f647aa307/src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentHost/agentHostSessionHandler.ts#L6605-L6610).
- Best-effort `session.options.update` and per-turn re-apply mirror [`CopilotAgentSession._applyEffectiveSandboxConfig`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/293593cce438781a8093ad49dd221cf50dcd0d7a/src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/copilot/copilotAgentSession.ts#L3550-L3568); `omitTransientSessionConfigValues` is shaped after [`omitHostOwnedSessionConfig`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/b176e3d456cb38e7e35baa7e8bd72c8f647aa307/src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/agentService.ts#L175-L181); the sandbox grant uses the existing precedence in [`buildSandboxConfigForSdk`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/b176e3d456cb38e7e35baa7e8bd72c8f647aa307/src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/copilot/sandboxConfigForSdk.ts#L116-L118).
